metadata.title: Who We Work With | MOCA Ventures
metadata.description: Discover how MOCA Ventures collaborates with developers, architects, construction managers, interior designers, trade partners, and building managers.

introduction: We collaborate with professionals across the architecture, construction, design, and property management industries, providing integrated solutions that combine European craftsmanship, technical expertise, reliable procurement, and precise project coordination.

process.label: Professionals who work with MOCA Ventures

steps.title: DEVELOPERS
steps.body: We support developers with tailored cabinetry and furnishing solutions that balance design quality, project requirements, budgets, and schedules, helping create distinctive residential and hospitality developments with lasting market value.

image.alt: Developer reviewing architectural plans and project drawings

steps.title: ARCHITECTS
steps.body: We collaborate closely with architects to translate their creative vision into technically precise, manufacturable solutions, ensuring that materials, finishes, proportions, and architectural details remain consistent throughout the project.

image.alt: Architects collaborating over plans and technical drawings

steps.title: CONSTRUCTION MANAGERS
steps.body: We coordinate with construction managers to align technical documentation, production schedules, logistics, delivery, and installation requirements, helping each project progress efficiently while maintaining quality and minimizing potential on-site challenges.

image.alt: Construction managers coordinating work at a project site

steps.title: INTERIOR DESIGNERS
steps.body: We work alongside interior designers to develop refined kitchens, bathrooms, cabinetry, and furnishings that complement their aesthetic direction while meeting the project’s functional, technical, and financial requirements.

image.alt: Interior designers reviewing colors and material samples

steps.title: TRADE PARTNERS
steps.body: We partner with experienced trade professionals, manufacturers, suppliers, and installers to ensure consistent quality, accurate production, efficient coordination, and reliable execution across every stage of the project.

steps.title: BUILDING MANAGERS
steps.body: We assist building managers with durable, functional, and carefully coordinated interior solutions designed to support daily operations, simplify maintenance, and preserve the quality and appearance of each property over time.

image.alt: Building manager meeting with a property services professional
